highlights.title: NASA hopes the commercial space industry can help save Hubble
highlights.summary: Gravity is a cruel mistress, slowly dragging the famed telescope ever closer to its ultimate demise with every day. Hubble is in no immediate danger of burning up in the Earth's atmosphere, but its time will run out in the early to mid 2030s unless its orbit is boosted.
body: The Hubble Space Telescope will come crashing to Earth sometime in the 2030s without a boost.

“Hubble still has important science ahead of it, and we should be looking at every reasonable opportunity to keep it delivering for as long as possible … If there are innovative and cost-effective ways to extend the life of an asset already on orbit, we owe it to the American taxpayer and the scientific community to explore them. Extending Hubble’s life would mean more discoveries, more science, and more opportunities to expand our understanding of the universe.”
The agency will keep the Request for Information open through November 30th at 3 PM ET.

highlights.title: 5 Classic Nintendo Games That Are So Good They Never Need a Remake
highlights.summary: Video games have been around for so many decades that the next time you sit down to play one, you’ll have tens of thousands of terrific options to choose from. A lot of us find ourselves playing newer releases when the time rolls around, because older titles have slipped from our minds.
body: Some of those old games will feel rough, and may include mechanics or stage designs we find difficult to enjoy. Others hold up remarkably well, to the point where the most we might ask for is a slight resolution adjustment, or a few quality-of-life improvements. Otherwise, they’re nearly perfect. In case you’re looking for titles that fit that bill today, here are five classic Nintendo games so good they never need a remake. Just keep making them available wherever you can, Nintendo, because they’re fine exactly as they are.

The Super Nintendo launched alongside Super Mario World. The pack-in game was a revelation, designed to perfectly utilize a bunch of new hardware perks. Sprites scaled. Parallax scrolled. Players could tap a shoulder button to let Mario look ahead and see upcoming hazards before they were all up in his face. Colors were richer and more varied.

highlights.title: Flock keeps ignoring requests to cancel its contracts
highlights.summary: While more cities are canceling their contracts with Flock Safety, just as many are discovering how difficult that can be in some instances. Plymouth, Minnesota's city council voted to terminate its contract with Flock in September, but failed to respond to the city's request.
body: Cities are canceling Flock contracts, but the company won’t take them down and sometimes is reinstalling them.

“After hearing nothing for more than a week, I directed our staff to disconnect the power cords from the cameras in order to be sure that they are not functioning or recording plates,” Fadden told The Drive.

Roughly 20 miles up the road, Dayton, Minnesota, is having its own issues with Flock. In this instance, the company acknowledged the city’s request and said it would take up to 60 days to remove the equipment. Despite this, Flock reconnected two cameras within the city limits without authorization, and following a specific request from the local police not to complete the work order.

On September 17, 2026, the Police Department was made aware of a maintenance work order produced by Flock. The City notified Flock on September 18, 2026, that the program was on hold, and no work orders were to be completed. Unfortunately, the City’s direction was not followed, and the camera was placed back into service without authorization.

highlights.title: Defensive 'masterclass' and elite Rice - how Arsenal ended Anfield torment
highlights.summary: Not since 2012 - when current boss Mikel Arteta was commanding Arsenal's midfield on the pitch - had the Gunners won on Liverpool’s patch. That curse has finally been broken.
body: Winning at Anfield is a rarity, especially for Arsenal. But Arteta's side were ruthless at both ends of the pitch, a tactical triumph for the boss and one that underlines his side's champion mentality.

"I love when there is something that we haven't done for many years," beamed the Spaniard, who praised his players for a defensive performance he called "remarkable". If Arteta wanted to make a statement, he succeeded.

Despite being pinned back in a first half dominated by Liverpool pressure, the visitors restricted their hosts to zero accurate shots - the first time on record the Reds failed to land at least one attempt on target at home.

"In the end, that defensive line, the way we stick together, that togetherness we have, is undefeated," midfielder Declan Rice reflected. "It's nothing I've ever seen before." Nine games in, Arsenal's title defence is going perfectly to plan.

highlights.title: Lymphatic Drainage: 4 Simple Habits to Add to Your Daily Routine
highlights.summary: From deep breathing to rebounding, experts explain the small daily habits that can help support healthy lymphatic flow—and why it matters beyond depuffing.
body: Lymphatic drainage has become something of a wellness obsession. From sculpting facial massages to body brushes and compression boots, there are seemingly endless ways to coax away puffiness and encourage a more contoured appearance. But the benefits of a healthy lymphatic system extend well beyond what we can see in the mirror.

The lymphatic system is sometimes described as the “Cinderella of medicine”: “underestimated, yet performing a large part of the essential work,” writes cardiothoracic surgeon Dr. Gerald M. Lemole in his book Lymph & Longevity: The Untapped Secret to Health. While its aesthetic benefits have helped bring lymphatic drainage into the mainstream, this intricate network of vessels, nodes, and fluid is fundamental to everything from immune function to maintaining the body's fluid balance.
And, as it turns out, keeping it functioning properly doesn’t necessarily require a standing appointment with your facialist.

Think of the lymphatic system as the body’s behind-the-scenes maintenance crew. Working alongside the circulatory and immune systems, it helps collect excess fluid from tissues, transports immune cells, and carries certain waste products away from cells.

highlights.title: AI Is Finding a Flood of Bugs, and Silicon Valley Is Rushing to Fix Them
highlights.summary: A.I. has uncovered a horde of software flaws, which engineers are racing to fix before they can be exploited and abused by hackers.
body: On Oct. 21, Fouad Matin, who leads OpenAI’s cyber-preparedness and safety efforts, had planned to spend the evening with friends to celebrate his birthday.

Instead, he was running on about two hours of sleep as he juggled efforts to patch two critical security vulnerabilities that had been discovered by artificial intelligence and that threatened to upend much of the internet. The work had entangled security researchers from start-ups and tech giants, as well as U.S. and international government officials.

More bugs that A.I. had found were also in Mr. Matin’s queue, and they needed fixes. OpenAI has several teams devoted to cybersecurity, and is pouring significant computing power into finding and fixing problems, Mr. Matin said.

A.I. “really opens this Pandora’s box of vulnerabilities,” he said. A.I. companies have a responsibility to track down and fix problems, he added, as “the true goal is to scan and patch as much of the world’s software as possible.”

highlights.title: Antonelli crowned world champion as Verstappen wins wild Mexico City GP
highlights.summary: Kimi Antonelli became the youngest Formula 1 world champion in history as Max Verstappen held off Lewis Hamilton to win a thrilling Mexico City Grand Prix.
body: Antonelli finished third to secure the F1 Drivers' Championship with four rounds to spare, becoming the first Italian world champion since Alberto Ascari in 1953.
The 20-year-old avoided all the chaos in one of the most action-packed races of the season and was hugely emotional after the chequered flag.
"We did it, we did it. I wouldn't be here without Mercedes, without my family, so I'm very grateful for this moment and it's one that will live forever," said Antonelli.
Meanwhile, Verstappen took advantage of a big fight between the Ferraris of Hamilton and Charles Leclerc on the opening lap to claim his third win in four races.

highlights.title: Forget maxxing your life. 2027 must be the year we relax – and start minning | Polly Hudson
highlights.summary: Maxxing is selfish, desperately try-hard and often futile. Instead of pushing your endeavours to the limit, minning means doing them less, if at all. Public service announcement: fellow citizens, we have maxxmaxxinged.
body: Maxxing is selfish, desperately try-hard and often futile – surely nobody who ever set out to funmaxx achieved it (see: New Year’s Eve), not even Dua Lipa. Minning is much more noble: it’s about making the world, rather than only yourself, better. Instead of pushing your endeavours to the limit, it means doing them less, if at all.

Back in the days when all of this was fields and we only used one x in “max”, it was clear that max volume is too loud, max capacity too crowded, and max power too draining. Somewhere along the way we lost sight of that. Let’s take a deep breath, and enjoy the relief of leaning into minning. First person to suggest they’re doing maxxminning will be taken to the tower and made an example of.
points: Maxxing is selfish, desperately try-hard and often futile.

highlights.title: Apple’s HomeView could add security camera features
highlights.summary: Reddit user pdfu found hints hidden in the HomeView 27.2 code that Apple could be adding security camera features to its smart home hub. The strings describe a security camera mode with motion detection, live streaming, and recording options, as well as privacy functions.
body: Code strings in HomeView’s software suggest Apple could launch a Secure Video feature soon.

Supposedly, the video feeds will only be visible to members of the home, and will both show an indicator light and play a sound when either someone is watching the camera feed or when it starts to record. Home members will also get a notification anytime settings are changed for the Secure Video mode. It will also include customizable options for what to detect, stream, or record, based on whether you’re home, away, or asleep.

Some wondered why Apple did not allow HomeView to double as a security camera at launch, and the company hasn’t said anything to suggest the features are coming. But, considering how central privacy is to Apple’s marketing, the company may be waiting to fine-tune those features before launch.

highlights.title: Spooky New Infostealer Malware Uses AI to ‘Autodox’ Victims
highlights.summary: Named “Volta-Autodoxer,” the recently uncovered malware uses AI tools to collect troves of data about victims, from login credentials and credit card numbers to Discord sessions and UberEats receipts.
body: New research shared exclusively with Kernel Panic shows that hackers have started adding AI functionality into a new strain of infostealer malware, making it possible for the system to automatically profile victims and quickly surface the highest value targets and their information. Dubbed “Volta-Autodoxer” because of how the malware refers to itself internally, the finding by Cisco Talos researchers sheds light on the ways that commercial LLMs are being used to augment and enhance the capabilities of established types of malware.

“Volta is pretty mature as a stealer. It casts a pretty wide net for what it collects,” says Ryan Fetterman, a security researcher at Cisco Talos. “It compiles all of those things together, ultimately producing a serialized dossier that it can send to a couple LLM models. It’s asking the model to act like an intelligence analyst and produce structured citation-backed assessment of the victim. It’s like a prioritization and analysis function.”

Talos flagged the malware using its new CAIRN framework, built to identify hacking tools that incorporate AI capabilities. Fetterman notes that Talos did not track whether Volta has been used in the wild.

highlights.title: Antonelli heads list of F1's youngest champions
highlights.summary: As Kimi Antonelli becomes F1's youngest world champion, we look at how his achievement compares with some of the drivers who previously held the record.
body: Kimi Antonelli has made history by becoming the youngest title winner in the 77th year of the Formula 1 World Championship.
The Italian, at 20 years and 68 days, has beaten the record of Sebastian Vettel, who was 23 years and 133 days old when he won the first of his four drivers' championships in 2010.
Antonelli, who was still a teenager until 25 August, has secured the title in his second season in the sport.
We take a look at F1's other young champions and how Antonelli's achievement compares with theirs.

highlights.title: Heat Director Michael Mann Hospitalized After Accidentally Shooting Himself in the Leg
highlights.summary: Heat director Michael Mann was hospitalized with minor injuries after accidentally shooting himself in the leg at a Los Angeles gun range on Halloween. TMZ confirmed the news with local authorities and the filmmaker's representative today.
body: "On Saturday, at a gun range, a weapon accidentally discharged while holstered resulting in a superficial injury to film director Michael Mann," his representative said this morning. "He was treated and is being released."

Mann is known for his role in developing some of the biggest crime dramas of the last 40 years and, as noted by TMZ, is a highly experienced target shooter himself. The site described the incident as having occurred during a training exercise of some kind, with its sources saying the 83-year-old director had no intention of harming himself. Additional details are unclear.

An ambulance ride to the hospital is probably not how Mann wanted to spend his Halloween in Los Angeles. While the accident took a bite out of his weekend, the filmmaker is currently putting the pieces of his long-awaited Heat follow-up together behind the scenes.

highlights.title: ‘Gintama: Yoshiwara in Flames’ Director and Producer Discuss Bringing the Cult Anime to the Big Screen
highlights.summary: “Gintama: Yoshiwara in Flames” – the latest iteration of the “Gintama” story – previewed this week at Lucca Comics and Games, Europe’s largest Comic-Con, prior to a theatrical release in Italy. Variety spoke with director Naoya Andô and producer Ryo Nakamuray about their continuation of the saga.
body: The manga became a long-running 367-episode anime series and has had three previous big-screen spin-offs. “Gintama: Yoshiwara in Flames” is the fourth cinema outing for the series.

How did you want to approach this franchise without losing its soul but at the same time making it suitably cinematic? Naoya Andô: When we started planning this film, we already knew that there would be many action scenes. We were keen to use the CinemaScope ultrawide ratio as well as using 3D in order to be able to move the camera more, and give us more variety, as well as keep the camera a little distant from the subjects so we could frame the shots better and really appreciate the design and setting. It’s for this reason we made this choice.

This story was already told in the TV series but despite the title Yoshiwara didn’t burn. But here we see it burn really. Naoya Andô: Our producer Takashi Maekawa also worked on the television series and so I asked him, are we going to actually burn the town this time? And the producer said: “Yes this time we’re going to burn everything.” And so we had talked among ourselves about how we were going to do it and the group made a creative decision to do it.
points: “Gintama: Yoshiwara in Flames” – the latest iteration of the “Gintama” story – previewed this week at Lucca Comics and Games, Europe’s largest Comic-Con, prior to a theatrical release in Italy.

highlights.summary: Ahead of The Gilded Age’s return to screens on November 1, dual celebrations on each coast saw the cast reunite for a red carpet outing at The Plaza and an elegant bash at Greystone Mansion in Beverly Hills.
body: At this week’s lavish season 4 premiere party at The Plaza, Carrie Coon, Cynthia Nixon, Audra McDonald, and their fellow stars left their bustles behind. After three seasons of elaborate period costumes, you’d think slipping into a corset every day would make dressing up for a night out a breeze. Alas, think again.

“It’s so much harder to get ready for a red carpet than it is for work,” Coon, clad in an Acne Studios gown, told Vogue. “My dresser, Amber, helps me get into my costumes and cinch my waist from a 28 to a 24. It takes about six minutes and 30 seconds to take off my costumes and wigs. Red carpets are way more stressful, and sometimes the clothes are just as challenging. For me, it’s the shoes. When you get to 16 hours in three-inch heels, you start to lose your mind!”

highlights.title: Ceramic vs Titanium Apple Watch: Which material is better for overall durability?
highlights.summary: An Apple Watch is a handy accessory for your iPhone, but choosing the most durable material can be challenging. This one is better suited to your needs.
body: Ceramic and titanium are both premium Apple Watch materials, but they excel in different ways.

Comparing Apple Watch casing materials, specifically titanium and ceramic, comes with varying degrees of counter-intuition. For one, titanium models feature ceramic components. Second, ceramic is harder than titanium, though titanium is the stronger material overall. There is a winner, but winning comes with caveats. Titanium is the better choice for consumers shopping primarily for long-lasting durability, but it's not as scratch-resistant as ceramic. As you can see, the comparison is a bit more complicated than the general assumption that titanium is the superior material.

In terms of abundance, titanium is the most practical premium option, since Apple hasn't manufactured a primarily ceramic Apple Watch casing since the Apple Watch Series 5. With the Apple Watch Series 12, Apple is bringing back the ceramic option (Pearl White and Midnight Blue), but that leaves ceramic several generations behind in terms of abundant, recent-generation availability.

highlights.title: Kimi Antonelli becomes youngest F1 champion with third place in Mexican GP
highlights.summary: 20-year-old clinches title with four races to go. Verstappen wins race ahead of Hamilton. Kimi Antonelli closed out with the cool command of the greats to win the Formula One world championship by taking third place in the Mexican Grand Prix, a race won after no little drama by Red Bull’s Max…
body: In taking his debut F1 title for Mercedes, the 20-year-old Antonelli has etched his name into the record books as the youngest driver to claim the sport’s crown and the first Italian to do so since Alberto Ascari won in 1953. It is Mercedes’ first drivers’ championship since Hamilton last won in 2020 and the team’s 10th.

Antonelli brought what has been a hugely successful campaign to a close as the sport’s 36th world champion at the Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez to claim the title in only his second season in F1 and with a full four meetings still to go. Sebastian Vettel was the previous youngest winner of the drivers’ championship, aged 23 in 2010, when Antonelli was just four years old.

The Italian has been leading from the front for almost the entire season, having taken the lead after the third round in Japan. With the Mercedes proving to be the class of the field in the opening half of the season under the new regulations, Antonelli made the most of it and established a dominant lead. He won five of the first six races, outracing his teammate George Russell, who had been the pre-season favourite.

highlights.title: Mobile’s Halloween tricks and treats: Clash of Clans, Talking Tom, Monopoly Go, Fortnite and more
highlights.summary: Halloween is almost here and with it comes a reliable range of mobile games tapping into the spooky season. In-game events, cosmetics and more can be found across all kinds of genres, as can a sizeable helping of pumpkins, witches and autumnal scenery.
body: Whether it’s Pokémon Sleep turning towards nightmarish ghosts like Gengar, or a growing cast of horror characters in Fortnite, there’s a good chance one game or other will land a scare.

This year, Epic Games, Zynga, The Pokémon Company, Scopely, Intelligent Systems and even The New York Times are among those dressing up their games for the occasion. Many of them also recently landed among our Top 50 Mobile Game Makers of 2026.

The aptly named Fortnitemares event has brought a month of cursed content to Epic Games’ flagship, tapping into a lineup of characters like Freddy Krueger, Ghost Face and Freddy Fazbear. In fact, characters from the Five Nights at Freddy’s universe are going all-in on the fright factor, with their outfits able to show battle damage.

Other IPs trickling in throughout October have included Hollow Knight, Slender Man, Beetlejuice and Obsession. Meanwhile, gameplay has seen players firing pumpkin rockets, teleporting around and dropping into Reload’s Nitemare Island.

highlights.title: Harry Styles Goes Full Pizza Rat for Halloween at Final MSG Show, Jalen Brunson Makes Surprise Visit
highlights.summary: The Hollywood Reporter was inside the arena Saturday night for night two of Styles' traditional "Harryween" concerts, where the musician gave an emotional farewell to his 30-show residency.
body: “I thought I would use this momentous occasion in my career to dress like a rodent,” Harry Styles said Saturday night, explaining his costume for the second night of his traditional “Harryween” concerts.

For night two of Harryween, Styles dressed as “Pizza Rat,” wearing a full rat suit and bringing a pizza slice onstage as an accessory. The costume appeared to take inspiration from the viral 2015 “Pizza Rat” video, which showed a rat dragging a slice of pizza down the stairs of a New York City subway station. Styles fully committed to the look, even playing guitar with his rat-claw nails.

His bandmates also got in on the New York theme, dressing as city landmarks and icons, including the Statue of Liberty, Andy Warhol and Anna Wintour. The previous night’s Harryween concert saw Styles transform into Elvis Presley before changing into the outfit he wore for his 2010 The X Factor UK audition.

highlights.title: At This Manhattan Halloween Party, 250 People Came Dressed as Dolly Parton
highlights.summary: The Frankie Shop and Unemployed paid homage to the late Dolly Parton with their raucous Halloween party at Ella Funt in Manhattan.
body: On Friday evening, swarms of Dolly Parton lookalikes took over the East Village for The Frankie Shop and Unemployed’s fourth annual Halloween bash. This year, the festivities tipped a rhinestone-covered cowboy hat to the late, great country music icon, with platinum-blonde bouffants, exaggerated bust lines, and plenty of pink as far as the eye could see.

By 10:30 p.m., guests sauntered downstairs to the basement club beneath Ella Funt, the East Village bistro turned late-night hotspot. The subterranean space was as ample as Dolly’s most famous asset—a surprising rarity in downtown Manhattan. Given the theme, it felt like a cross between a Brooklyn warehouse and a Dollywood fever dream, with the wood paneling and hot-pink walls illuminated by a soft rosy glow. At the center of it all was a sunken black-and-white checkered dance floor, though you could barely make out the floor underneath all the dancing Dollys.
points: The Frankie Shop and Unemployed paid homage to the late Dolly Parton with their raucous Halloween party at Ella Funt in Manhattan.
